characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: SEM; Mag = 2.00 K X; EHT = 20.00 kV
characterization_methods.key_findings: Hollow κ-phase cocoon shell with evacuated core inside α, the residue of fully decomposed austenite.
characterization_methods.purpose: Reveal the three-dimensional κ-phase morphology after isothermal treatment at 870 °C for 15 min.

interfaces.phase_evolution: Complete decomposition of austenite into κ-phase, leaving a hollow κ cocoon shell (former austenite site evacuated) within ferrite.

processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Isothermal treatment in the two-phase ferrite + j-phase (κ) domain; promotes complete decomposition of austenite, leaving a κ-phase cocoon.
Deep etching used to expose the three-dimensional κ-phase cocoon morphology for SEM observation.

phases_present.morphology: matrix (α) surrounding the κ cocoon shell
hollow cocoon shell with evacuated core

structures.overall_structure: Complete decomposition of austenite; ferrite (α) matrix containing hollow κ-phase (j-phase) cocoon shells with evacuated cores
